action_bible.principle: Action is survival under failing recognition, not consequence-free spectacle.

episode_budget.minor_bursts: one or two sequences of 20-60 seconds

camera_rules: Establish geography with a readable wide shot before acceleration.
Keep screen direction stable and show the objective in the frame.
Use close-ups for decisions and injury consequences, not random impact clutter.
Represent prosopagnosia through delayed recognition, eyelines, sound and mismatched reaction; never physically erase faces.
Reserve handheld motion and speed-line accents for short peaks.
Every major sequence ends with a persistent cost: time, injury, medicine, trust or route access.
akira_combat_rules: Akira carries exactly one matte-black rescue katana used by Red Line route crews to cut composite seals, cables and disabled machines.
Crimson Arc is a trained defensive footwork pattern, not an energy power.
Against people she prioritizes evasion, the sheath, joint control and environmental escape.
The exposed blade is reserved for drones, locked infrastructure and immediate lethal threats.
No red energy trail, projectile slash, teleport step, effortless crowd defeat or instant healing.
Her balance, reaction time and spatial certainty worsen with the infection clock.

signature_set_pieces.name: Cold-chain rooftop run
signature_set_pieces.objective: Keep Elias's case below its temperature limit while crossing retracting maintenance bridges.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: MNEMOS survey drones and a closing district gate.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: A drone correctly calls Akira by name before she knows she is being hunted.
signature_set_pieces.cost: She damages the case coolant and starts a visible delivery countdown.

signature_set_pieces.name: North Ring checkpoint collapse
signature_set_pieces.objective: Extract civilians as the biometric gate repeatedly assigns them to the wrong families.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Panic, riot shutters and security officers following contradictory identities.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Akira must trust Sera's voice while fighting the instinct that she is a stranger.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Their escape seals the district behind them.

signature_set_pieces.name: Red Line blind route
signature_set_pieces.objective: Stop a driverless evacuation train before it reaches a quarantined platform.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Maintenance drones, live rails, flooding and Akira's failing spatial map.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Mina guides Akira by sound markers, but a forged marker sends her toward the live rail.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Akira saves the train but publicly exposes her infection.

signature_set_pieces.name: Silent transmitter ascent
signature_set_pieces.objective: Restore Mina's radio relay without speaking over monitored channels.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Vertical service shafts, patrol drones and gesture-only coordination.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Sera must identify Akira from her door-tap habit rather than her face.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Sera burns her first layer of MNEMOS clearance.

signature_set_pieces.name: Zero-degree clinic evacuation
signature_set_pieces.objective: Move unstable patients between overheated and freezing wards during a power cascade.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Fire shutters, seizure hazards and incompatible patient identity records.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Mina gives her own verified place to a patient who cannot prove who they are.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Mina misses her safe evacuation window and becomes infected.

signature_set_pieces.name: Vault 80 evidence breach
signature_set_pieces.objective: Recover the original LIMEN trial ledger before thermal sterilization destroys it.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Archive guardians, collapsing cold-storage racks and Varga's containment team.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Multiple guards wear identical MNEMOS-guided masks; behavior, not faces, reveals the insider helping Akira.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Maelle's authorship becomes public with the evidence.

signature_set_pieces.name: MNEMOS Spire ascent
signature_set_pieces.objective: Reach the public audit core before compulsory ADEX-R deployment begins.
signature_set_pieces.opposition: Layered security, failing elevators and Varga's disciplined continuity unit.
signature_set_pieces.identity_twist: Varga offers Akira a perfect digital reconstruction of Mina's memories; accepting it would invalidate Mina's consent.
signature_set_pieces.cost: Akira destroys the reconstruction and loses the easiest way to be remembered.

action_bible.wan_assembly_rule: A set piece is edited from approved 3-5 second image-to-video shots, held keyframes, reaction inserts, effects and sound layers; no model is asked to generate a continuous multi-minute fight.
